top_signals.title: Even Claude says AI watermarking is no ‘silver bullet’
top_signals.summary: Claude has questioned whether watermarking AI-generated text can ever provide a foolproof way to identify machine-written material, just days after its maker, Anthropic, began embedding invisible marks into the chatbot’s own output.
